abdn_home_a_quine.text: Fit like? That is Doric for how are you. A loon is a boy and a quine is a girl. I will not guess which you are.
This house is granite, like the rest of the street. Grey in the rain, sparkly in the sun, because of the mica.
My gran says granite from the Rubislaw quarry built half the city, and bits of London's Waterloo Bridge too.

then.text: Back for the Cullen Skink? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Fit like? Come away in. You'll take a bowl of skink.
Finnan haddie poached in milk, flaked, then mash a few tatties into it to thicken. Pepper, butter, done. A skink was a shin of beef once. Don't ask me how the fish got in.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
